scientific_integrity: Analytical support-function and Gaussian quantile arguments establish the theorem; finite numerical checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for proof. Historical novelty is assessed with residual literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact width expression holds for m>=2 and n>=1; limit holds for positive finite n/m ratio. No uniform remainder, other scaling regime, or all generalized permutohedra statement. Historical priority provisional; a different notation for this special mean width remains possible.
title: A half-density phase transition for Haar mean widths of partial permutohedra
